checks.name: Release application and three Worker dry builds
Packaged skill, changed prose, strict future, repository consistency and whitespace

acceptance_evidence: Only active/waiting/someday/cancelled desired states accept on exact existing nonarchived noncompleted Todos. Mixed patches, direct completion, paused desired state, missing/archived/non-Todo targets, projection and stale revisions fail.

Canonical state edits preserve task order/details, organization, dates, dependencies, completion/restoration/metadata history and every retained game mapping with zero accepted task activity events and game effects. Existing accepted game commands remain independent.

Current goal eligibility and active dependency candidates reflect native state; cancellation neither completes a task nor satisfies a prerequisite. Separate completion and exact-event restoration retain history ownership.
Portable validation rejects altered desired-state snapshots and fabricated completion/effect fields. v7 hashes bind exact state while prior encodings/defaults and enum values remain stable.

Actual synthetic SDK accepts all four desired states, preserves the original waiting snapshot after later changes, recovers original request/command receipts and enforces public/private grants and profile isolation with zero upstream writes.
Browser controller acknowledgement-loss recovery and client preview/effect guards retain exact original state/target intent.

A packaged synthetic project/goal journey composes native organization creation, task placement, dependency assignment, cancellation/reactivation and separate native completion; pending game effects are never cancelled or retried.

operations.outcome: Initial focused checks identified fixture-only mismatches: collection reference equality, query result property and workspace identity inconsistent with retained history. Repaired focused checks pass.
The first full Worker run hit the existing Cron file 30-second deadline. The complete isolated Cron file passed 17 checks in 13.349 seconds; full Worker requalification passed all 326 checks.

limitations: Production authoring controls, optional separate execution stages, actual host/client/device qualification and real gameplay remain outside this local milestone.
No deployment was needed for local implementation or synthetic qualification.
